hero.title: Precision immune-specificity mapping to understand human health and disease
hero.description: The Kohlgruber Lab specializes in immune-specificity mapping with a focus on T cells to understand the antigen-specific basis of human diseases. To achieve this we leverage a combination of high-throughput genetic screens, single-cell profiling technologies, and synthetic biology approaches on human patient samples, combined with preclinical mouse models. Our goal is to mechanistically understand autoimmunity, cancer, and infectious diseases, and generate next-generation therapies that target immune-specificities rather than be broadly acting.

culture_preview: Our lab combines rigorous science with hands-on, supportive mentorship, transparent communication, and shared celebration of each other’s progress and individual milestones.
